newsitem.title: CANADA: Cambridge, Cadillac set C$100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge, Cadillac set C$100 mln bond.

text.p: Cambridge Shopping Centres Ltd and Cadillac Fairview Corp on Thursday set C$100 million in 6.82 percent first mortgage bonds in financial markets, RBC Dominion Securities said on Friday.
The C$100 million issue due January 31, 2007 was priced at par with accured interest, if any. The issue will be dated on or about July 10, 1997.
The issue will be secured by the Fairview Mall in Toronto, with proceeds evenly divided between Cadillac Fairview and Cambridge.
The series D bond will pay interest on July 31 and January 31 beginning on January 31, 1998.
